access.title: No access to the chemical register
access.body: This page needs the right to see safety (safety.view). Ask whoever manages roles in your company.

band.label: Chemicals actions
band.exportHint: From Export ▾ in the register's toolbar: the rows you see, as CSV or Excel.
band.requestsLater: Later: asking suppliers for a newer sheet comes in a later wave.

withoutSds.label: Products without SDS
withoutSds.hint: No current safety data sheet at all

toRequest.label: SDS to request
toRequest.hint: No current sheet in the company's language: ask the supplier

cabinets.label: Cabinets
cabinets.hint: Cabinets with a QR to print

law.register: The employer assesses the risk of the chemical agents in use, starting from what is in the register.
law.sds: Workers have access to the safety data sheets of the substances they use.

register.title: Chemical register
register.label: Chemical register
register.search: Search product, supplier, place or H code
register.empty: Add your glues and solvents first: each with its pictograms, where it is kept and its safety data sheet.
register.noneFilteredHint: Change the filters or clear them.
register.moreHeld: The register shows 500 products at most: narrow it with the filters.

library.title: SDS library
library.label: Safety data sheets
library.offline: The site's tablets keep every current sheet: the cabinet QR opens them without network.
library.openPdf: Open {name}, the sheet of {chemical}, in a new tab
library.missing_one: 1 product in use has no safety data sheet:
library.missing_other: {count} products in use have no safety data sheet:
library.addFirstNamed: Add the safety data sheet of {chemical}
library.empty: Each product's sheet is added from its window (Replace SDS) or with Add chemical.

field.name: Product
field.namePlaceholder: The trade name on the label
field.usePick: Choose what it is used for
field.supplierNameHint: When it is not one of our suppliers (or leave it empty).
field.hazardHint: As on the label or the sheet, section 2: H225 H319 EUH066.
field.badHazard: "{code}" is not a hazard statement as CLP writes it (H225, H319, EUH066).
field.badPrecaution: "{code}" is not a precautionary statement as CLP writes it (P210, P305+P351+P338).
field.placeHint: The room and the shelf or cabinet: Glue cabinet, cutting room.
field.cabinetHint: The code its QR names (no spaces): CAB-CUT-1. Empty when it is not in a cabinet.
field.maxQuantityHint: The most kept at one time (optional), with its unit.
field.noRoles: The site has no role sheets yet: the safety officer writes them with the risk assessment.
field.noPpe: The company has no PPE items yet.

sheet.dropHint: The supplier's safety data sheet, as a PDF.

add.title: Add chemical
add.noSite: no site chosen: choose one in the top bar
add.sheetHint: Optional now: you can add it later with Replace SDS.
add.sheetRefused: The chemical is in the register, but its sheet was not taken.
add.openToReplace: Open it to add the sheet

replace.hint: The newer sheet becomes the current one of its language; the one before is kept, superseded.
replace.first: This will be the first sheet in this language.
replace.supersedes: Version {version} in {language} will be kept, superseded.
replace.floor: The site's tablets take the new sheet the next time they are online.

archive.reason: Why it is no longer in use
archive.kept: Archived products and their sheets are kept; they leave the register in use, the tiles and the cabinet's list.

window.noSheets: No sheet yet: add it with Replace SDS.
window.pickSheet: Choose a sheet to show it here.

qr.title: Print cabinet QR
qr.empty: A cabinet is the code a chemical names (Cabinet code): add it to a chemical first.
qr.withoutSheet_one: 1 of them has no safety data sheet yet.
qr.withoutSheet_other: {count} of them have no safety data sheet yet.
qr.howItWorks: A tablet of the site that scans this QR (Scan anything) opens the cabinet's products and their current sheets from what it keeps, also without network.
qr.labelScan: Scan for the safety data sheets

sdsTab.title: Safety data sheet: {name}
sdsTab.superseded: A newer sheet replaced this one: follow the current one.

cabinetTab.title: Cabinet {cabinet}
cabinetTab.scan: Scan the QR with a tablet of the site (Scan anything) to read each product's safety data sheet, also without network.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.moves: Previous / next chemical in its window

held.company: Open a company first (the top bar): a chemical belongs to one of its sites.
held.manage: The chemical register is kept by the safety officer (safety.chemicals.manage).
held.archived: This chemical is archived: put it back in use first.
held.siteId: Choose a site of the company.
held.use: Choose what it is used for.
held.supplierParty: Choose the supplier, or name it.
held.name: Name the product (at most 200 characters).
held.supplierName: Name the supplier as one of ours or by name, one of the two (at most 200 characters).
held.hazardStatements: Write each H statement once, as CLP writes it (H225, EUH066).
held.precautionStatements: Write each P statement once, as CLP writes it (P210, P305+P351+P338).
held.signalWord: A signal word comes with its hazards: add the pictograms or the H statements.
held.storagePlace: Say where it is kept (at most 200 characters).
held.cabinetCode: A cabinet's code has no spaces (at most 40 characters).
held.maxQuantity: The most kept is a number above 0 (at most four decimals), with its unit.
held.maxQuantityUnit: The most kept comes with its unit: both, or neither.
held.note: A note has at most 1000 characters.
held.pdf: A safety data sheet is a PDF.
held.contentType: A safety data sheet is a PDF.
held.versionLabel: Type the sheet's version (at most 50 characters).
held.revisedFuture: The revision day is today at the latest.
held.reason: Say why it is no longer in use.

refusal.ARCHIVED: This chemical is archived: put it back in use first.
refusal.NOT_ARCHIVED: This chemical is in use already.
refusal.SITE_OTHER_COMPANY: The site is not one of the company's sites.
refusal.SUPPLIER_OTHER_COMPANY: The supplier is not an active supplier of this company or the group.
refusal.ROLE_OTHER_SITE: The roles must be role sheets of the chemical's own site.
refusal.PPE_OTHER_COMPANY: The PPE items must be of the company's own catalogue.
refusal.FILE_NOT_READY: The PDF is not ready to be read at the cabinet yet: upload it again.
refusal.FILE_NOT_PDF: A safety data sheet is a PDF.
refusal.OLDER_THAN_CURRENT: This sheet was revised before the current one (version {version}): a replacement is the newer sheet.
refusal.SAME_VERSION: Version {version} in this language is the current sheet already.

problem.read: The server did not answer as expected. Nothing is lost: try again.
problem.unavailable: The server is not available right now. Try again shortly.
problem.noAnswer: No answer from the server: check the connection and try again.
problem.invalid: Something in the form is not valid.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You don't have the right to do this here.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been archived, or it is not of your company.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again; check and try again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time: wait a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

saved.replaced: Version {version} is now the current sheet; {old} is kept, superseded.
saved.firstSheet: Version {version} is now the current sheet.
saved.archived: Archived: it left the register in use; its sheets are kept.
